signInToView.where: Schedule page, message when nobody is signed in

back.where: Schedule page header, accessible name (aria-label) of the back arrow button

title.context: the musicians' service schedule (who plays which service)

mine.where: Schedule page header, toggle pill that shows only the viewer's own assignments

switchToList.where: Schedule page header, accessible name of the view toggle while the calendar is shown

switchToCalendar.where: Schedule page header, accessible name of the view toggle while the list is shown

confirmedStat.where: Schedule page stats bar, word after a number of confirmed assignments (e.g. '3 confirmed'; the number is a separate element before it)
confirmedStat.context: count is the number shown just before this word; use it for plural agreement

pendingStat.where: Schedule page stats bar, word after a number of assignments awaiting a reply (e.g. '2 pending')
pendingStat.context: count is the number shown just before this word; use it for plural agreement

noMusiciansAssigned.where: Schedule page, dashed box under a service that has no musicians yet

emptyMineTitle.where: Schedule page empty state heading with 'Mine' turned on

emptyMineBody.where: Schedule page empty state text with 'Mine' turned on

emptyAllBody.context: 'musician picker' and 'setlist editor' are parts of the app where leaders assign musicians

dateTbd.where: Schedule page, beside a service name when the service has no date ('to be determined')

statusPending.where: Schedule page, small status pill on a musician's row (shown capitalised by CSS)
statusPending.context: the musician has not replied yet

statusConfirmed.where: Schedule page, small status pill on a musician's row (shown capitalised by CSS)

statusDeclined.where: Schedule page, small status pill on a musician's row (shown capitalised by CSS)

statusCancelled.where: Schedule page, small status pill on a musician's row (shown capitalised by CSS)

toastConfirmed.where: Assignment card, toast after the musician accepted a service

toastDeclined.where: Assignment card, toast after the musician declined a service

respondFailed.where: Assignment card, error toast when accept/decline failed

musicianWithInstrument.where: Assignment card, small pill naming another musician on the same service and their instrument
musicianWithInstrument.context: {musicianName} is a person's name, {instrument} their instrument (e.g. 'Guitar')

moreMusicians.where: Assignment card, after the first five other musicians ('+3 more')
moreMusicians.context: {count} is how many more musicians are not listed

accept.where: Assignment card, button to accept playing the service

decline.where: Assignment card, button to decline playing the service

viewSetlist.where: Assignment card, link to the service's setlist

badgeAutoConfirmed.where: Assignment card, status badge (top corner) when the musician was confirmed automatically

badgePending.where: Assignment card, status badge (top corner) while waiting for the musician's reply

cardDateTbd.where: Assignment card, under the service name when the service has no date
